articles.summary: Stripe's new white paper is the clearest public account of how it optimises on-session payments. Read from the failed payments side, its own framework makes the case for a seventh stage: the failed renewal, where subscription revenue actually lives.
articles.title: Stripe's AI optimisation paper, read from the failed payments side

articles.summary: A benchmark of 407 subscription companies that replaced their billing platform's retry model with FlyCode: recovery rate before and after, lift by failure cause, platform and business model, and what still did not recover.
articles.title: The State of Failed Payment Recovery in 2026: Benchmarks From 407 Subscription Companies
